text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Bitcoin's larger loss suggesting selective pressure on the largest assets as risk appetite weakens. The Fear & Greed index at 13 signals extreme fear, reinforced by a sharp 12-point drop over the past week, indicating investor sentiment has deteriorated significantly. Despite the selloff, Bitcoin dominance holding near 59% and total volume at $82B suggest the market is still functioning—this is a period of caution and repositioning rather than capitulation or panic liquidation.
